# UI micro feel audit, 2026-10-14

## CHECKPOINT

ER11 complete. MC22-MC33 source review, numeric formatter inventory, asset coverage and isolated desktop probes are below. Findings and fixes are proposals. Only this research file and the ER11 lane were written. No shared source, shared `dist/`, saves, private packs, commits or installs were changed.

Measurement owner: [ER11 report](../gm/dispatch/engine-runtime-2026-10-14/ER11/REPORT.md). The frozen candidate is `/tmp/yairpg-er11-mg8hxm66`. References below use its source line numbers unless marked **late READ**. Shared runtime changed during the audit; the candidate does not prove that newer source. Resume by checking `build-evidence.json` and the affected owners before another probe.

Target: **1366×768, desktop/laptop**. Visible outcome sought: routine controls stay under the pointer and in keyboard focus, numeric readouts stay clear, and presentation failures do not strand play. Mobile optimization, new gameplay, engine migration and deployment policy changes are deferred. This follows [User vision](../USER_VISION.md#standing-ui-priority-2026-10-13).

This extends [ER1 hotspots](RUNTIME_HOTSPOT_AUDIT_2026-10-14.md), especially ER1-F4/F5/F10, and [ER3 stack options](TECH_STACK_OPTIONS_2026-10-14.md). It does not repeat E1-E10 of the [save/scale review](../ENGINE_SAVES_AND_SCALE_REVIEW_2026-10-11.md) or F1-F9 of the [offline audit](OFFLINE_TIME_AND_BRANCH_CLOCK_AUDIT_2026-10-14.md). The [root palette](../ENGINE_RUNTIME_PERFORMANCE_AND_STACK_CONSIDERATIONS_2026-10-14.md#k-subtle-micro-stuff-mc-round-3) keeps product authority.

## Findings ranked by player exposure

Order is INFERRED frequency, not severity or measured input latency. Severity describes a long campaign: annoyance, wrong outcome, or possible loss of unsaved progress. READ proves a source path; MEASURED proves only the stated probe. No source fix is implemented here.

| Rank / code / palette | Finding, evidence and severity | Minimal reproduction | Smallest fix proposal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 / ER11-F1 / MC22, RT3, PF5 | **Layout reads interleave with writes on routine polls.** READ `src/workspace_views.js:34-48,62` calls `updateWorkspace()` every 250 ms even when its view signature is unchanged. `src/workspace_layout.js:132-165,199-208` writes module dimensions/hidden state, then reads root, toolbar, footer and shell geometry, including for docked modules. This extends ER1-F5 with the specific per-module write/read chain. MEASURED opening: 312 layouts and 736 style recalculations in 5 s, 56.226 ms total layout time, 31.702 ms style time. **Annoyance/cost risk**, not a proven slow frame. | Leave a fresh Workspace opening idle and record browser Layout events; compare the same scene with one cached geometry frame and dirty layout updates. | Read common bounds once before writes; skip float bounds for docked modules; update only changed layout properties. Moderate cost because gestures, scale and resize still need fresh bounds. |
| 2 / ER11-F2 / MC26, MC29, PF8 | **Numeric presentation varies across surfaces; main counters lack an explicit numeral policy.** READ formatter inventory below. MEASURED purse, calendar, health and stamina compute `font-variant-numeric: normal` with `system-ui, sans-serif`. Titles force US grouping, XP uses host-locale grouping/scientific output, newer panels interpolate raw counts. **Annoyance**; actual glyph-width jitter is unmeasured and some fonts already have equal-width digits. | Compare the same count in titles, XP and a raw-count panel under two locales; switch the allowed font and cross digit boundaries. | Add tabular numerals to counter/timer selectors, then use domain-specific shared helpers for counts, probabilities and durations. Small CSS cost; moderate formatter adoption. Keep coin denomination semantics and exact quoted costs. |
| 3 / ER11-F3 / MC23, MC24, PF5 | **Changed progress can replace active controls and selected prose.** READ `src/village_career_ui.js:12-13,60-63` rebuilds buttons when the full career/study signature changes. `src/titles_ui.js:12-28` rebuilds every title family when progress changes. `src/absorb_d/ui.js:20-33` rebuilds controls on money/stock/known-item changes. MEASURED synthetic career progress: focused practice button detached, equivalent button exists, focus falls to BODY. Synthetic visible title selection changes from `Audit title` to empty when progress changes. **Annoyance**, with a possible missed click under a pressed pointer. | Focus a career control while practice progresses; select title prose while its counter changes; hold pointer down across a refresh before releasing. | Keep keyed controls and prose nodes, change only status/count text. Export tooltip uses unpadded `h:m:s`. **Annoyance**, encountered during reading/work. | Read a one-minute remainder; inspect zero work duration and an export countdown crossing 10 seconds. | Pluralize the rounded displayed count; define explicit zero text and padded real-time units. ## Scope corrections and existing protections

| Code | READ evidence and implication |
| --- | --- |
| ER11-P1 | `src/display.js:1474,1622-1756` caches inventory rows and updates/removes by keys. It is not a blanket full-list rebuild per tick. Sorting/reparenting still merits a pointer test. `src/content_pack_ui.js:8-10,25-47` and `src/structured_pack_ui.js:10,63-99` keep keyed action/job controls. |
| ER11-P2 | `src/work_ledger_ui.js:40-44,94` restores an equivalent focus key, but rebuilds the body and uses `focus()` without `preventScroll`. `src/crafting_detail.js:31-35,119` similarly restores control kind/index with `preventScroll`; it does not preserve DOM identity, text selection or arbitrary open/select state. `src/workspace_layout.js:185` restores still-connected focus when moving a panel. These mitigate some focus loss, not pointer replacement. |
| ER11-P3 | `src/display.js:89-106,1033-1052` keeps the log at its prior reading position unless near bottom or Follow always; it tracks unread lines. Appending then reading `scrollHeight` still crosses a layout boundary, but deleting history/reading log height is not alone evidence of a broken scroll policy. |
| ER11-P4 | `src/trade.js:88-101` commits synchronously then `cancel_trade()` clears selections, so a second accept sees an empty basket. `src/main.js:1004-1016` stages against a current quote. `src/work_ledger_ui.js:18-35` blocks while busy, awaits command settlement, and resets in finally. `src/action_legibility_ui.js:180-210`, `src/ink_narrative_ui.js:70-78`, and `src/causal_story_ui.js:161-187` have pending/busy guards. No blanket claim that all paid buttons double-charge. |
| ER11-P5 | `src/main.js:631-656` equipment repair is synchronous, rechecks state via `stageRepair`, and rerenders after publication. A second click after a full repair is not evidence of a second payable repair. Structured/pack controls recheck state and disable in-flight jobs. Sequence checks reject stale requests, but a new click using a fresh sequence is a new request, not inherently idempotent. |
| ER11-P6 | `src/main.js:964-1000` wraps a broad post-save render group; its first thrown panel still skips later panels in that group. Some earlier post-durable panel calls sit outside that catch (`934`). `src/display_settings.js:79-85` isolates commit listeners, but registration broadcasts (`44-45`) do not isolate each listener. `src/ink_narrative_ui.js:102` catches projection errors. These are partial protections, not a global fault boundary. |
| ER11-P7 | `src/settled_text_effects.js:13,59-66,127-132,156,188-195` and `src/native_discovery_feedback.js:34,59-62` respect hidden state/motion or cancel effects. Workspace CSS disables animation duration/transition/scroll motion in reduced mode (`styles/workspace.css:123-127`); discovery CSS has its own media rule (`styles/workspace_discovery.css:10-12`). Canvas weather is timeout+rAF (`src/display.js:5929-5936`), not an independent recurring hidden interval: rAF gates its next iteration. Background animation defaults off (`src/main.js:1789`). It lacks an explicit system-motion/visibility lifecycle, but do not claim 60 Hz hidden rendering. |
| ER11-P8 | Lesser read/write sites: location mode writes CSS then reads another computed property (`src/display.js:2160-2161,2796-2797`); coin feedback appends then measures (`src/settled_text_effects.js:168-172`); target pulse writes geometry then reads overlay width every active frame (`19-24`); canvas changes width then reads client height (`src/display.js:5910-5912`). These are READ candidates, not separately timed forced-layout events. |

## Numeric formatter inventory

READ inventory includes all named numeric display helpers found by the searches in the lane report, their inline numeric conversion sites, and output families. Raw `${number}` interpolation is a separate widespread output family, not an undocumented compact-number formatter. No `Intl.NumberFormat`, `toPrecision`, or k/M abbreviation helper was found in the reviewed source. [Conversion inventory](../gm/dispatch/engine-runtime-2026-10-14/ER11/number-inventory.txt), [native inline sites](../gm/dispatch/engine-runtime-2026-10-14/ER11/display-number-sites.txt), and [cross-source inline sites](../gm/dispatch/engine-runtime-2026-10-14/ER11/inline-number-sites.txt) preserve the searches. Incidental arithmetic `minutes` locals in the first list are not display formatters.

| Code | Helper / file:line | Output style |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ER11-N1 | `expo`, `src/misc.js:83-98` | Default precision 3 after decimal in exponent output; configurable threshold; otherwise host-locale rounded integer above 10, up to one decimal above 1, up to two decimals below. Numeric 0 rather than string. F7 sign/magnitude bug. |
| ER11-N2 | `round`, `src/display.js:425-427` | `+toFixed(1)`: at most one decimal, trailing zero removed; item stat comparisons. |
| ER11-N3 | `format_money`, `src/display.js:4217-4241` | HTML coin spans: G=100000, S=1000, C=10, W=1. Descending nonzero denominations, sign prefix; zero says `nothing`. W remainder is not rounded. The documented `round` argument is not accepted by the implementation. |
| ER11-N4 | `formatCoins` / `parsePurse`, `src/settled_text_effects.js:141-153` | Plain text same G/S/C/W scale, floors each nonzero part; parser recognizes digit+unit text after the purse colon. Designed for spent integers, not a general signed/fractional formatter. |
| ER11-N5 | `format_time`, `src/game_time.js:137-185` | Ceiling minute count; optional carries, compact `Y/M/D/h/m` or singular/plural long names with trailing spaces; zero empty. Explicit tabular coverage is limited to status-stat values (`styles/status_window.css:4`), craft requirement counts (`styles/crafting_detail.css:47`) and themed tables/previews (`styles/component_themes.css:44,72,83`). This is a high-frequency F3 candidate once encounters are enabled. |

## Measured evidence and limits

Command: `node docs/gm/dispatch/engine-runtime-2026-10-14/ER11/probe.cjs`, after `node build.js` in the copied `/tmp` tree and `python3 -m http.server 0 --bind 127.0.0.1` there. Fresh Playwright context, headless local Chrome, viewport 1366×768, origin `http://127.0.0.1:49873`. Normal PLAY and public synthetic hero creation were used; no personal save or pack was loaded. Browser and server were closed.

Final run: 5,000 ms observation; 312 layouts; 736 style recalculations; 56.226 ms layout, 31.702 ms style, 627.953 ms aggregate task duration; zero page errors. Aggregate task time is not max long task or input latency. The 250 ms write/read chain is READ; the page-wide metric does not attribute every layout to it. No timing threshold is claimed to fail.

Served bundle SHA-256: `012297afd9c7a4d0884beb775bceb5c82004876f23100270461ea72d2246554f`, matches candidate bytes. Bundle 5,102,764 bytes; map 13,106,520 bytes. All 501 source-map entries were reconciled: 464 match physically present build inputs; 37 missing upstream TypeScript paths match embedded content in the pinned dependency map. Measurements confirm frequent layout work (F1), absent explicit numeral policy on four counters (F2), and component focus/selection loss (F3). Component double-click and source-function number probes add F5/F7 evidence. They do not prove native paid spending, full campaign scroll/hover behavior or latest-source acceptance.

The title fixture explicitly opens its details and makes its host visible/selectable, matching the reading condition; earlier hidden/unselectable runs could not establish selection loss. The career fixture has validated earned promotion and offered-method prerequisites. Formatter functions are extracted unchanged from frozen source and evaluated with a synthetic threshold of 6; they are not substituted into the native runtime.

No Node gameplay suite was run for this read-only audit. Open: native double-spend journey; pointer press across a tick; font-dependent width jitter; actual hidden/suspend cadence; injected panel-failure recovery; cached release transition and public source-map policy; browser proof for the late source. No gameplay completion or director taste acceptance is claimed.
